newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 23.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA) launches competition for a logo design which will reflect its mission to promote regional economic integration; first prize 2,000,000 CFA francs, according to a statement published by the Ivorian government daily.
- Gasoline and diesel pump prices rise following government liberalisation of prices in the sector; government flagged the move as a way of stimulating competition and lowering prices.

- Abidjan palm oil factory owned by state agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie plus hotel complex and Assinie coconut plantation to be formally handed over to the private sector on Tuesday; government, which divied the company into blocs to privatise it, approved sale of the three units last week.
